title: Evaluation of Hate Speech Detection using Large Language Models and Geographical Contextualization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the models' ability to correctly identify the geographical region (Arab, Bangladesh, India, China, or Russia/Ukraine) of comments and testing how geographical context impacts hate speech classification accuracy.

Assessing hate speech detection performance on a multilingual dataset composed of comments originally in Arabic, Bengali, Hindi, Chinese, and Russian to measure model adaptability and disparities across different linguistic contexts.
